title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Pennsylvania
description: Late-evening food and snack stops on campus and in nearby University City, using current public hours or Penn Dining’s late-night designation.

cards.title: Starbucks at 1920 Commons
cards.subtitle: 3800 Locust Walk, on campus
cards.notes: Use the downstairs 1920 Commons location for coffee, tea, pastries, or a snack; confirm the weekly schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Penn Dining location explicitly designated for late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Dining lists this Starbucks as a “Late Night” retail location and says it serves from early morning to late night.
cards.access_notes: Penn Dining currently labels it “Late Night”; weekly schedules can vary and should be checked through the linked schedule.

cards.title: Gourmet Grocer
cards.subtitle: 1920 Commons, 3800 Locust Walk
cards.notes: Pick up prepared food, snacks, essentials, or produce inside 1920 Commons, then check the current weekly schedule for that night.
cards.short_summary: A campus market identified by Penn Dining as a late-night option.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Dining labels Gourmet Grocer “Late Night” and describes it as open from early to late.
cards.access_notes: Penn Dining currently designates it “Late Night”; consult its linked weekly schedule because operating times can change.

cards.title: 1920 Commons
cards.subtitle: 3800 Locust Walk, west of the 38th Street Bridge
cards.notes: Head to the large dining café for an evening meal; check the current meal-period schedule, especially during breaks and summer.
cards.short_summary: Penn’s large Locust Walk dining café is described as serving from early to late.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Dining states that 1920 Commons is the largest café on campus and serves from early to late.
cards.access_notes: Penn Dining describes service as early to late; use the page’s weekly-schedule link to verify the date-specific closing time.

cards.title: Domino's on Chestnut Street
cards.subtitle: 4438 Chestnut Street, West Philadelphia
cards.notes: Use carryout or delivery from the West Philadelphia store when you need a food option after most nearby counters have closed.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizza location whose official listing shows service until 2 a.m. today.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location page for 4438 Chestnut Street lists the store as open today until 2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently shows “Open Today Until 2:00 AM”; hours vary by day, so recheck before ordering.

cards.title: Greek Lady
cards.subtitle: University City
cards.notes: Choose a sit-down or takeout meal from the University City restaurant when an 11 p.m. closing fits your evening plans.
cards.short_summary: A University City restaurant with official daily hours through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Greek Lady’s official site says it is in University City and open daily from 9:30 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site currently lists daily hours of 9:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; check before travel for exceptions.

cards.title: Renata's Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 3940 Baltimore Avenue, University City
cards.notes: Plan a dinner stop at the Baltimore Avenue restaurant Tuesday through Saturday, allowing time to arrive before the listed 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A University City restaurant whose official site lists 11 p.m. closing on Tuesday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Renata’s Kitchen lists its address as 3940 Baltimore Avenue and hours Tuesday–Saturday from 10 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site currently lists Tuesday–Saturday service until 11 p.m.; it is closed Mondays and closes earlier Sunday.

cards.title: Landmark Americana University City
cards.subtitle: 3333 Market Street, University City
cards.notes: Use the food menu, not the bar program: the official site lists late-night kitchen service on every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Market Street restaurant with a separately listed late-night food schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Landmark Americana’s University City page lists kitchen hours until 11 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday and midnight Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Landmark Americana University City — Contact and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official page currently lists late-night kitchen service: until 11 p.m. Sun–Wed and midnight Thu–Sat; food service ends before venue closing.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Philadelphia-founded late-night bakery
cards.notes: Use the official store finder to select a nearby location and verify its night’s hours before placing a cookie or ice-cream order.
cards.short_summary: A late-night bakery brand founded in a University of Pennsylvania dorm room.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies states that the company was founded in a University of Pennsylvania dorm room and describes itself as serving warm cookies late into the night.
cards.access_notes: The official source establishes late-night service generally; verify the chosen Philadelphia store’s current hours in the official store finder.

cards.title: CO-OP Restaurant & Bar
cards.subtitle: 33rd and Chestnut Streets, University City
cards.notes: Make it an early-evening-to-late-evening meal stop inside The Study at University City; consult the restaurant’s current hours page before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant located at the 33rd-and-Chestnut edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CO-OP’s official page places the restaurant in University City at the corner of 33rd and Chestnut Streets, inside The Study hotel.
cards.access_notes: Use the official hours-and-location page to confirm same-day late service; it is a restaurant open to under-21 diners.

cards.title: Hill House Dining Cafe
cards.subtitle: 3333 Walnut Street, Hill College House
cards.notes: Use Hill’s food-hall-style dining café for an evening meal on the east side of campus; verify the evening meal period first.
cards.short_summary: A large east-campus dining café with seating around Hill’s atrium.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Dining identifies Hill House as the largest dining café on the east side of campus at the corner of 34th and Walnut Streets.
cards.access_notes: Penn Dining’s current location listing shows meal periods and links to the weekly schedule; evening availability varies by academic calendar.

warnings: Several Penn Dining locations provide a late-night designation or “early to late” description rather than a fixed daily closing time; check the linked weekly schedule before going.
